title: I Can Hear The Heart Beating As One
notes:
Track A2 embodies portions of the composition "Bird Bath" written by Burt Bacharach

Label error: B4 "Autumn Sweater" is not listed. B5 "Little Honda" is listed as B4 and given an incorrect timing of 5:17, which is the correct timing of the unlisted "Autumn Sweater." 

Some copies came with 3 heart-shaped stickers writing  "YO" "LA" and "TENGO," respectively.

Issued with two (different) printed inner sleeves.

Copies of this pressing can be identified by Matador Records' fourth address (625 Broadway, New York, NY 10012), written on the back-cover. 

The only way to distinguish this version from the 2002 US repress is that here all four labels are perfectly flat while the 2002 has large pressing rings on side 2 and 3.

Runouts are etched, except for the "MASTERDISK" stamp on sides A and C. Side designations are given as "one", "two", "three", "four" on back sleeve and as "side one", "side two", "side three", "side four" on labels.
